auth_type.correction: dynamic website-issued token (x-auth-token; no developer signup or API key)

example.correction: The static POST /api/search request with only Content-Type is stale. Current clients dynamically discover the internal search path, fetch an initialization token, and supply the required website headers and token.

notes: HLTB publishes no official public API documentation, pricing, authentication, CORS, or rate-limit policy. The linked ckatzorke wrapper exists but newer package documentation calls it abandoned and nonfunctional after HLTB API changes. The sample response is also internally wrong: game_id 10270 identifies The Witcher 3, not Breath of the Wild.
